name: signupgenius-mcp
description: SignUpGenius MCP — read sign-ups, slots and groups, RSVP, and claim or release slots. Three auth paths: Pro API key, email/password, or sign in via the ContextMint Bridge browser extension.

signupgenius_email.title: Email (session mode)
signupgenius_email.description: SignUpGenius login email. Pair with the password below to enable session mode — works on free accounts and supports every tool except slot reports. Direct email/password accounts only (no Google/Apple/Facebook/Microsoft SSO, no 2FA). Leave blank to use the ContextMint Bridge browser extension instead.

signupgenius_password.title: Password (session mode)
signupgenius_password.description: SignUpGenius password. Required only when the email above is set. Stored locally in the bundle config — keep it private.

signupgenius_user_key.title: Pro API key (key mode)
signupgenius_user_key.description: SignUpGenius API key from Pro Tools > API Management. Required ONLY for the slot REPORT tools (filled/available/all participants) — those need a Pro subscription. If both this and email/password are set, the key wins.

signupgenius_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable browser bridge (advanced)
signupgenius_disable_fetchproxy.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback (missing credentials become a hard error — useful in headless CI).

signupgenius_session_cache.title: Cache the session between runs
signupgenius_session_cache.description: Cache the email/password session on disk between runs (default on). Turn off to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start.

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
